description: Plan a flow of paid x402 services for a goal, paid with a signed x402 payment ($0.02, USDC on Base or Solana). Settled only after a plan is produced; nothing found = not charged. If the answer is settlement_pending, do NOT pay again.

budgetUsd.description: Warn when one run of the flow would cost more than this

goal.description: What you want done, in plain words (3 to 600 characters)

maxSteps.description: At most this many steps (1 to 5)

networks.description: Only services payable on these networks, e.g. ["base","solana"]

paymentPayload.description: The signed x402 payment (v2 relayed as PAYMENT-SIGNATURE, v1 as X-Payment), as JSON or base64

name: plan_flow_with_payment
